name: smwmusic-sonic-triple-trouble-sunset-park-zone-act
title: Sonic Triple Trouble - Sunset Park Zone Act 3
description:
The cinematically tense theme from Sonic Triple Trouble's train level.

As a Game Gear/Master System song, the original is sort of plain, yet I wanted to stay accurate to it note-wise. Instead of introducing extra melodies, I opted to do a bunch of pitchmod nonsense instead to give it a fuller sound.
